246: (Exodus 38:22) "Betzalel, son of Uri, son of Chur, of the tribe of Yehudah, etc.: Rabbi Yehudah said, "Behold, it was stated that, behold, he was from the right side, and he established the refinement of everything. Moreover, behold, Yehudah was the leader and the king over all the other tribes. So from him came out the one who established the entire tabernacle." Betzalel: Behold, they explained it, "In the shadow of God (Be tzel El)." And who is in the shadow of God? The Right. From that side, everything was established. And he inherited Wisdom to do all of the work.

"With him was Oholiav, son of Achisamach, of the tribe of Dan": This one is from the left side, this one is from the side of strict (another version, holy) judgement. Behold, they explained it, that the tabernacle was made from these two sides, and was established by them to be connected with them in order to be between right and left. And behold, it was said and explained.
